description:
List domains in the authenticated Porkbun account. Returns one page (up to 1000) with metadata: expire date, auto-renew, security lock, WHOIS privacy, API access opt-in, and notLocal flag.

Filters (all optional):
- `domain`: exact match. Returns 0 or 1.
- `name_contains`: substring search on domain name.
- `tlds`: limit to these TLDs (no leading dot).
- `expiring_within_days`: only domains expiring within N days. Useful for renewal automation.
- `added_after` / `added_before`: when the domain joined this account at Porkbun, by registration or transfer (`addedDate`). Pass the newest `addedDate` already seen as `added_after` to fetch only new domains.
- `created_after` / `created_before`: registry creation date (`createDate`); a transferred-in domain keeps its original one.
- `expires_after` / `expires_before`: expiry window by date.
- `auto_renew`: 'yes' or 'no'.
- `api_access`: 'yes' or 'no'. Filter to domains an API key can actually operate on — eliminates `API_ACCESS_DISABLED` errors downstream.
- `sort_name`: 'domain' | 'tld' | 'create_date' | 'added_date' | 'expire_date'. Default expire_date.

Dates are YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, UTC. *_after includes the moment, *_before excludes it.
- `sort_direction`: 'asc' | 'desc'. Default asc.

For a single domain by name, use `get_domain` instead — cleaner shape and 404-on-not-found semantics.

added_after.description: Only domains added to the account (registered or transferred in) at or after this date/date-time, UTC.

added_before.description: Only domains added to the account before this date/date-time, UTC.

api_access.description: Filter to domains opted in to API access.

auto_renew.description: Filter to domains with auto-renew on or off.

created_after.description: Only domains whose registry creation date is at or after this date/date-time, UTC.

created_before.description: Only domains whose registry creation date is before this date/date-time, UTC.

domain.description: Exact domain match — returns 0 or 1 result.

expires_after.description: Only domains expiring at or after this date/date-time, UTC.

expires_before.description: Only domains expiring before this date/date-time, UTC.

expiring_within_days.description: Only domains expiring within this many days from now.

include_labels.description: Include user-defined domain labels in the response.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring on the full domain name.

tlds.description: Limit to these TLDs (no leading dot). Example: ['com', 'io']

name: list_domains
title: List Domains
